extDescription.message: Type text with human simulation on active web pages.

openSidebarBtnTitle.message: Open in side panel so it stays open when switching focus

defaultStatusPopup.message: Click 'Start Typing', then immediately click the target input field on the page before countdown finishes.

defaultStatusSidebar.message: Click 'Start Typing', then focus your cursor into the document/input field on the active web page.

tipPopupNote.message: Tip: Use Open Sidebar if you want the panel to stay open when switching focus or typing long documents.

tipSidebarNote.message: The sidebar panel stays open when you click the document page.

sourceTip.message: Content source: type/paste directly, automatically fetch from public Google Docs link, or upload a .txt/.html file.

textTip.message: Content of the document/text to simulate typing automatically on the active web page.

wpmTip.message: Typing speed in Words Per Minute (constant or random between two constants).

delayTip.message: Wait time before typing begins. Gives you time to click the target input field on the web page.

waveTip.message: Length of human rhythm cycle (typing speed will gradually wave up and down like natural human rhythm).

startTip.message: Initial typing tempo: 'Fast' then slower, or 'Slow' then gradually faster.

typoTip.message: Chance of mistyping neighboring keyboard keys (e.g. 0.03 = 3% chance per character).

seedTip.message: Random number generator seed (RNG). Using the same number reproduces identical speed and typo patterns.

thinkEveryTip.message: Number of words typed before a natural human thinking pause (constant or random range).

thinkPauseTip.message: Duration of thinking pause in seconds (constant or random range).

typoWordsTip.message: How many words are typed after a typo occurs before realizing it and backspacing.

typoDelayTip.message: Pause duration when realizing a mistake before starting to backspace.

noTypoTip.message: Check this option for 100% accurate typing without any mistype simulation.

statusDocsInvalidUrl.message: Invalid Google Docs URL. Make sure the link format is https://docs.google.com/document/d/...

statusDocsDownloadError.message: Failed to download document. Ensure Google Docs sharing is set to public ('Anyone with the link').

statusDocsLoaded.message: Google Docs text loaded successfully ($1 characters; HTML/CSS not counted).

statusSidebarMenu1.message: Open Firefox browser menu > Sidebar > AutoKetik.

statusSidebarMenu2.message: Open Firefox menu: Press Alt, then select View > Sidebar > AutoKetik.

statusTextEmpty.message: Text is still empty. Please enter or paste text first.

statusEnterTextFirst.message: Please enter or paste the text you want to type first.

statusProtectedPage.message: Extension cannot run on Firefox system pages (about:). Open a normal web page tab.

statusCountdown.message: Countdown $1 seconds... Click the target field on the page now!

statusTypingStarted.message: Typing started on active field in page.

statusScriptNotActive.message: Script is not active on this tab yet. Please reload (Refresh / F5) your web tab and try again.

typingCountdown.message: Countdown $1 seconds... Focus cursor on target field.

typingTargetError.message: Failed: No active input field. Click a text field or editor on the page and try again.

typingWarnEnter.message: Warning: Enter key is not accepted by this editor.

typingErrorDocs.message: Failed: Google Docs rejected text input. Open Console (F12) for details.

typingErrorEditor.message: Failed: editor rejected text input. Open Console (F12) for details.

typingWarnTypoDisabled.message: Warning: Docs rejected deletion, typo simulation disabled. Check the last word.
